raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The direct external linker rejects FULL + MAMBA models with MLA full attention, such as Kimi-K3 (MLA + KDA): `_MambaStrategy` has no linker pool group, and non-packed draft KV (DSPARK) raises at startup.

## Modifications

- `_MambaStrategy` builds a linker pool group: the MLA KV (paged) plus the existing Mamba slot entry. It is not `rank_replicated`, since the Mamba state is TP-sharded.
- DSPARK draft KV shares the target KV slots, so it is a `DRAFT` entry indexed from the KV transfer, the layout HiCache already uses for sidecar drafts. Sidecar pools reach the linker through `CacheInitParams.sidecar_draft_device_pools`. A model whose linker group has no `DRAFT` entry fails at startup instead of dropping the draft KV.
- Rejected at startup: non-plain-MLA full-attention pools, `--dcp-size > 1`, packed draft KV, and more than one sidecar draft pool.

## Accuracy Tests

Oracle: the same request served from a device hit, then after `/flush_cache` from a Mooncake host hit at the same prefix. Output ids, logprobs and `spec_verify_ct` must be equal. Negative controls (box-only probe) fill the destination rows with 0xA5, then skip one pool's load.

| setup | normal load | load skipped |
|---|---|---|
| CI: `kimi-linear-tiny-random`, 1 GPU | 4/4 exact | MAMBA or KV skipped: fails |
| Kimi-K3, 8x B300 TP8 (cookbook Low-Latency) | 24/24 exact | MAMBA: 1/8 ids equal; KV: 0/8 |
| Kimi-K3 + DSPARK (block 7) | 32/32 exact, same accept length | DRAFT: logprobs 0/8, `spec_verify_ct` 3/8 |

Kimi-K3 TP8 is bit-deterministic run to run, but GPU work from another thread shifts its output even on a pure device hit, so a poisoned *normal* load is not bit-exact there. The loaded bytes were checked directly instead: they equal the stored bytes and are intact when the forward reads them.

## Known limitations

- Each TP rank stores its own copy of the MLA KV.
- With DSPARK, a lookup needs the `DRAFT` objects, so prefixes written without speculation do not hit.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests-adding-tests).
- [x] Provide accuracy evaluation results.

+def _build_mamba_device_pool_group(
+    kvcache: Any, params: Any, page_size: int
+) -> DevicePoolGroup:
+    from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hybrid_cache.hybrid_pool_assembler import (
+        _stage_local_layer_mapping,

+    )
+
+    # TODO(alphabetc1): support other full-attention pools, DCP and packed draft KV.
+    full_kv_pool = kvcache.full_kv_pool
+    if (
+        type(kvcache) is not HybridLinearKVPool
+        or type(full_kv_pool) is not MLATokenToKVPool
+        or get_parallel().attn_dcp_size > 1
+        or params.mtp_draft_device_pools
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "The direct external linker supports FULL + MAMBA models only with a "
+            "plain MLA pool, without DCP or packed draft KV."
+        )
+
+    entries = [
+        DevicePoolEntry(
+            name=PoolName.KV,
+            indices_from_pool=PoolName.KV,
+            device_pool=full_kv_pool,
+            components=[full_kv_pool.kv_buffer],
+            layer_mapping=_stage_local_layer_mapping(
+                kvcache.full_attention_layer_id_mapping, kvcache.start_layer
+            ),
+            page_size=page_size,
+            rows_are_pages=False,
+        ),
+        _mamba_device_pool_entry(params.req_to_token_pool, kvcache.start_layer),
+    ]
+    for draft_pool in params.sidecar_draft_device_pools:
+        if draft_pool.page_size != page_size:
+            raise ValueError("Draft KV page size must match the tree page size.")
+        # Draft layer i rides transfer layer i; the draft reads it only after
+        # the batch's loads finish.
+        entries.append(
+            _mha_device_pool_entry(
+                PoolName.DRAFT,
+                draft_pool,
+                {layer: layer for layer in range(draft_pool.layer_num)},
+                page_size,
+                indices_from_pool=PoolName.KV,
+            )
+        )
+    num_layers = max(layer for entry in entries for layer in entry.layer_mapping)
+    # Not rank_replicated: the Mamba state is TP-sharded.
+    return DevicePoolGroup(entries, num_layers + 1, page_size)

+"""Mooncake direct linker on Kimi Linear (MLA + KDA, as Kimi-K3): a host hit decodes
+bit-for-bit like a device hit."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.kits.unified_radix_cache_kit import _random_suffixes
+from sglang.test.kl_test_utils import (
+    _extract_output_logprobs,
+    _flush_cache,
+    _generate,
+    get_input_ids,
+)

+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,

+    find_available_port,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    terminate_and_kill_process_tree,
+    unified_radix_tree_server_env,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(
+    est_time=180,
+    stage="extra-b",
+    # Direct GPU transfers require an RDMA-capable runner, even for TP=1.
+    runner_config="4-gpu-h100",
+)
+
+_MODEL_PATH = "yujiepan/kimi-linear-tiny-random"
+
+PAGE_SIZE = 64
+TRACK_INTERVAL = 128
+# A checkpoint boundary; requests end inside the next page so both hits stop here.
+PREFIX_LEN = 1024
+
+
+class TestKimiLinearUnifiedCacheLinker(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.model = _MODEL_PATH
+        cls.base_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{find_available_port(30000)}"
+        cls.mooncake = MooncakeTestServices()
+        cls.addClassCleanup(cls.mooncake.stop)
+        cls.mooncake.start()
+        other_args = [
+            "--trust-remote-code",
+            "--attention-backend",
+            "triton",
+            "--linear-attn-backend",
+            "triton",
+            "--mamba-backend",
+            "triton",
+            "--page-size",
+            str(PAGE_SIZE),
+            "--mamba-radix-cache-strategy",
+            "extra_buffer",
+            "--mamba-track-interval",
+            str(TRACK_INTERVAL),
+            "--enable-deterministic-inference",
+            "--mem-fraction-static",
+            "0.6",
+            "--max-running-requests",
+            "1",
+            "--enable-cache-report",
+            "--enable-unified-cache-external-linker",
+        ]
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=other_args,
+            env=unified_radix_tree_server_env("python", **cls.mooncake.server_env()),
+        )
+        cls.addClassCleanup(
+            terminate_and_kill_process_tree, cls.process, wait_timeout=60
+        )
+        cls.input_ids = get_input_ids(
+            tokenizer_path=cls.model, num_samples=4, trust_remote_code=True
+        )
+
+    def test_host_hit_matches_device_hit(self):
+        prompts = [list(ids[: PREFIX_LEN + 1]) for ids in self.input_ids]
+        for ids in prompts:
+            _generate(self.base_url, [ids], 1)
+        requests = [
+            prompt + suffix
+            for prompt, suffix in zip(
+                prompts, _random_suffixes(len(prompts), PAGE_SIZE - 1, seed=100)
+            )
+        ]
+
+        run = lambda: [
+            _generate(self.base_url, [ids], 32, return_logprob=True)[0]
+            for ids in requests
+        ]
+        device_results = run()
+        _flush_cache(self.base_url)
+        host_results = run()
+
+        for device, host in zip(device_results, host_results):
+            for result, host_tokens in ((device, 0), (host, PREFIX_LEN)):
+                meta = result["meta_info"]
+                details = meta.get("cached_tokens_details") or {}
+                self.assertEqual(meta["cached_tokens"], PREFIX_LEN)
+                self.assertEqual(int(details.get("host", 0)), host_tokens)
+            self.assertEqual(host["output_ids"], device["output_ids"])
+            self.assertEqual(
+                _extract_output_logprobs(host), _extract_output_logprobs(device)
+            )
+
+

+                    linker_pool_assembler,
+                    "get_memory",
+                    return_value=SimpleNamespace(enable_unified_memory=False),
+                ),
+                patch.object(
+                    linker_pool_assembler,
+                    "get_parallel",
+                    return_value=SimpleNamespace(attn_dcp_size=dcp_size),
+                ),
+            ):
+                return resolve_hybrid_device_pool_group(
+                    kvcache=kvcache,
+                    page_size=2,
+                    params=params,
+                    components={ComponentType.FULL, ComponentType.MAMBA},
+                )
+
+        group = resolve()
+        self.assertEqual(group.num_layers, 4)
+        self.assertFalse(group.rank_replicated)
+        kv, mamba = group.entry_map[PoolName.KV], group.entry_map[PoolName.MAMBA]
+        self.assertEqual(kv.layer_mapping, {1: 0, 3: 1})
+        self.assertEqual(mamba.layer_mapping, {0: 0, 2: 1})
+        self.assertEqual(kv.prepare_locations(torch.tensor([2, 3])), [2])
+        self.assertEqual(mamba.prepare_locations(torch.tensor([3])), [3])
+        self.assertEqual(group.sources[PoolName.DRAFT], PoolName.KV)
+        self.assertEqual(group.entry_map[PoolName.DRAFT].layer_mapping, {0: (0, 1)})
+
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "plain MLA"):
+            resolve(dcp_size=2)
+        params.mtp_draft_device_pools = (object(),)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "plain MLA"):
+            resolve()
+        params.mtp_draft_device_pools = ()
+        kvcache.full_kv_pool = MHATokenToKVPool.__new__(MHATokenToKVPool)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "plain MLA"):
+            resolve()
+
+    def test_unsupported_strategy_fails_with_context(self):
+        from sglang.srt.mem_cache.swa_memory_pool import SWAKVPool
+
+        kvcache = SWAKVPool.__new__(SWAKVPool)
         with self.assertRaisesRegex(
             ValueError,
-            "does not support the direct external linker: _MambaStrategy",
+            "does not support the direct external linker: _SwaStrategy",
         ):
             resolve_hybrid_device_pool_group(
                 kvcache=kvcache,
                 page_size=2,
                 params=SimpleNamespace(),
-                components={ComponentType.FULL, ComponentType.MAMBA},

             )
